purpose: Per-deposit external-metadata sidecar for a fresh alexanarch deposit. Contains OpenAlex work IDs for CITED works only — a deposit has no OpenAlex id of its own; Wikidata QIDs for external entities named in the deposit; DataCite severance status for cited DOIs. Complements the registry.json entry, which holds the core concepts/citations/entities. Generated by enrich_deposit.py.

deposit_work_matches_withdrawn.reason: These were the top hits of a full-text OpenAlex search on the deposit title, recorded as matches without any threshold, title comparison, or author check. An alexanarch deposit has no OpenAlex work id: OpenAlex indexes Crossref, DataCite, PubMed and the repositories it harvests, and this archive is not among them. The step searched for an identifier that cannot exist, and search always returns something. The ids are retained here as a record of what was asserted, and are withdrawn as matches.
